attributes.title: AASV 58th Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 58th AASV Annual Meeting runs February 27 to March 2, 2027, at the Hilton Orlando Buena Vista Palace in Orlando, Florida. The meeting offers continuing education and networking for swine veterinarians; veterinarians and veterinary students may register, others must meet eligibility rules.

Registration opens in December 2026. AASV members pay $570 if they preregister by February 5, 2027, and $680 after; non-member veterinarians pay $1,050, and veterinary student members attend free. AASV does not seek RACE approval for its sessions, and the CE hours for 2027 have not been published yet. There is no virtual attendance option, although some talks are recorded for members.
